mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_coin_order_history ( uuid , order_side , order_type , market , order_time , profit_rate , loss_rate , time_limit ) VALUES ( #{order.uuid} , #{order.side} , #{order.ordType} , #{order.market} , NOW() , (SELECT value FROM tb_config WHERE "group" = 'BID' AND key = 'profit_rate') , (SELECT value FROM tb_config WHERE "group" = 'ASK' AND key = 'loss_rate') , (SELECT value FROM tb_config WHERE "group" = 'ASK' AND key = 'time_limit') )
mapper.select: SELECT uuid , order_side , order_type , market , order_time , profit_rate , loss_rate , time_limit FROM tb_coin_order_history ORDER BY order_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT market , ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(uuid), ',') AS uuid_list FROM ( SELECT market AS market , "uuid" AS uuid FROM tb_coin_order_history ORDER BY order_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) GROUP BY market
